mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week improvement in TRANSIT from -28.7 to -23.6 signals a durable return of commuting and out-of-home routines, which raises weekday retail footfall and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -28.7 at t-3w to -23.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean of -21.7 when TRANSIT continues to improve or stays above -25.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains above 7.5, indicating persistent work-from-home, which suppresses retail footfall; a fall below 7.0 marks a shift back to offices and raises RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 9.7 at t-3w and 7.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL falls below 7.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES above their recent means creates a commuting-retail multiplier: when both exceed -25 and -20 respectively, foot traffic to retail and recreation rises over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT > -25 and WORKPLACES > -20 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT -23.6 and WORKPLACES -17.7 at t-0w already meet thresholds
failure_condition: If weeks meeting the joint threshold are followed by RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean in more than half of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Cooler autumn weather pushes PARKS below -30, shifting leisure spending indoors; this seasonal substitution lifts RETAIL_REC over the next week relative to the autumn outdoor baseline.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -32.7 at t-1w and -32.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -30 but RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than its prior 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Employer return-to-office mandates lift WORKPLACES above -18, increasing CBD footfall; retail and recreation follows with a two-week lag as commuters resume in-person shopping.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -24.3 at t-3w to -17.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays above -18 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM remains below -13 and PARKS below -30, lingering caution and outdoor avoidance dominate; this combination suppresses discretionary retail trips and drags RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM < -13 and PARKS < -30 in the same week
failure_condition: If the joint condition holds but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL stays above 7.5 as hybrid work persists, keeping daytime residential populations high and reducing trips to retail-and-recreation venues, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL averaged 8.45 over the last four weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above 7.5 but RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not lower than its prior 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -22 signals the final phase of commuting recovery; this threshold crossing releases delayed retail demand and lifts RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT rises above -22 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its prior 14-day mean.
